tickets.title: Open and Prepare New Account
tickets.text: Use this workflow to prepare, submit, and confirm a new client account opening package for Nolan Pebblefizz and Lila Pebblefizz. Confirm account purpose as a joint taxable advisory account with transfer‑on‑death registration, funding of cash exceeding their $120,000 reserve, a moderate‑growth, tax‑sensitive objective, and avoidance of additional Paper Otter Analytics concentration.

subTasks.title: Confirm account profile and registration
subTasks.text: Verify the intended account type, ownership or registration, tax classification if applicable, investment objective, risk tolerance, and any special restrictions before paperwork is prepared.

subTasks.title: Prepare and review account documents
subTasks.text: Complete the custodian or platform forms, advisory agreement items, fee schedule references, beneficiary fields if applicable, and required disclosures. Review for missing signatures, inconsistent addresses, and incomplete identity information.

subTasks.title: Submit opening package and track approval
subTasks.text: Submit the account package through the appropriate channel and monitor for approval, rejection, or additional information requests. Record any follow-up items in the client record.

subTasks.title: Confirm funding and first operational setup
subTasks.text: Confirm funding instructions, transfer status, cash availability, model or allocation setup, statement delivery preference, and online access readiness before closing the workflow.

tickets.evidence: They agreed to proceed with the account-opening work by 2024-11-01.
